On physical exam a systolic crescendo-decrescendo murmur is heard best at the right 2nd intercostal space. This murmur was not heard at the patient's last appointment six months ago. Which of the following would most support a diagnosis of aortic stenosis?

The option 'Murmur radiates to carotid arteries bilaterally' would most support the diagnosis of aortic stenosis as this characteristic radiation pattern is typical for aortic stenosis.
